title.text: Tasks · When and Deadline at a glance (proposed)

howto.text:
How to try it

• Press Play, then click inside once so it has the keys.
• The strip's Dates, Wording and Overdue cue switch the open choices. Sections 1 and 2 hold the wording at Absolute; section 3 compares the wordings.
• Hover a date for its full date and distance; click it for the popover.
• Narrow the detail pane or the window: the list name gives way, then the When; a deadline always stays.

n_weak.text:
What's weak now

• When and Deadline are the same grey capsule; only an 11pt glyph tells them apart.
• A deadline says “Due” only on the day: tomorrow's reads “Tomorrow”, like a plan.
• Two steps of urgency; due tomorrow looks like nothing.
• Every dated row has a capsule, so the deadline that matters doesn't stand out.
• At narrow widths the chips never give way (feedback 16).

n_dates.text:
Every variant: a deadline says “Due” (in words; Compact lets the flag say it); overdue is red, due today amber, due tomorrow an amber flag; the tooltip has the full date and distance.

B: a capsule then always means something is due. The plan (When) sits back as quiet text.

t_cue.text: 2 · An overdue cue on the row

n_cue.text: Off (B in Today, above) is recommended: the red capsule already marks the row. If more is wanted, the checkbox beats the edge: it's on the task, not the row's chrome.

n_views.text:
Today leaves out a When on or before today. Upcoming doesn't repeat the day. Completed, Trash and done rows show no dates.

Narrow (feedback 16, as built): the title keeps 120pt; dates keep their size, the When dropping first; the list name truncates. A deadline always shows.

t_detail.text: The detail pane and the popover

t_words.text: 3 · Wording: absolute, relative under two weeks, or compact

n_words.text:
Compact is recommended: every date is its distance from today, at any range. 2d, 13d, 3w, 2mo, 1y; overdue “2d ago”.

• Urgency is the number, so it's comparable down the column and across a row (“2d · 3d”: planned a day before it's due).
• It's the narrowest, so a When drops less often at narrow widths.
• What it gives up, the weekday and the date, is in the tooltip and the detail pane.
• “2d ago” over “−2d”: it reads as words, and a minus sign at 11pt is easy to miss or read as a dash. The red capsule already says late.

In compact, a deadline needn't say “Due”: the flag and the capsule say it. Today stays a word, never “0d”.

n_words2.text:
Costs to weigh

• Tomorrow is “1d”, not a word.
• A plan this week loses its weekday (“Fri” becomes “6d”).
• Far dates are coarse (“2mo”).
• Upcoming already groups by day, and “3d” under Monday counts from today, not Monday. The tooltip settles it.
